follow-up time: 11.2 years after their last birth (mean age 43.9 years)
cohort: 42,872 mothers in the Danish National Birth Cohort
finding: Women with only cesarean births or whose last birth was by cesarean reported slightly more symptoms of depression and stress in midlife compared with women with vaginal births.
mod_finding: Women with only cesarean births or whose last birth was by cesarean reported slightly more symptoms of depression and stress in midlife compared with women with vaginal births.
